ambiguities.quote: if the attack roll had Advantage
ambiguities.reading_a: The roll 'had Advantage' only if Advantage actually applied, so it was rolled with two d20s. If Advantage and Disadvantage cancel, the rider doesn't apply.
ambiguities.reading_b: The roll 'had Advantage' whenever any source granted Advantage, even if Disadvantage cancelled it.
ambiguities.proposed_ruling: Reading A. GLOSS.advantage says the two 'cancel each other', so the roll has neither, and the extra 1d4 is not added.

gaps.quote: Gear Leather Armor, Scimitar, Shield, Shortbow
gaps.explanation: AC 15 equals Leather Armor (11) + Dex (+2) + Shield (+2), but the unit doesn't say whether AC is recalculated if the goblin loses or drops its Shield or armor. The listed Shortbow also has no Ammunition, and no rule here says whether a monster's ammunition is tracked.

traps.note: In 2014 the goblin was a Small Humanoid (goblinoid), Neutral Evil. In 2024 it is Fey, so effects keyed to creature type (Humanoid vs Fey) resolve differently.

traps.quote: plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage
traps.note: The 2014 goblin attacks had no Advantage damage rider. Both the Scimitar and the Shortbow need the conditional 1d4.

traps.quote: Nimble Escape. The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
traps.note: The wording matches 2014, but the 2024 Hide action is a DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) check that needs Heavy Obscurement or Three-Quarters/Total Cover and grants the Invisible condition. In 2014 it was a check contested against Perception.
2014 stat blocks had no Initiative entry. 2024 lists a modifier and a score (10 + Dex modifier), and the score can be used instead of rolling.
+6 is more than Dex (+2) + PB (+2). The listed bonus must be used as written, not recomputed from proficiency.

output.summary: This is the stat block for the Goblin Warrior, a CR 1/4 Small Fey (Goblinoid): AC 15, HP 10 (3d6), Speed 30 ft., and Stealth +6. It has a Scimitar attack and a Shortbow attack. Each hits with +4 for 1d6+2 damage, plus 1d4 if the attack roll had Advantage. Nimble Escape lets it take the Disengage or Hide action as a Bonus Action. The derived numbers check out: Initiative 12 = 10 + Dex modifier, and Passive Perception 9 = 10 + Wis modifier (−1). The one real ambiguity is whether the Advantage rider applies when Advantage and Disadvantage cancel. The main 2014 traps are the change from Humanoid to Fey, the higher HP, the new Advantage damage rider, and the 2024 Hide mechanics behind Nimble Escape.
